title: Phone-number structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of NANP phone-number candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectPhones`` regex at PIIDetector.swift:491 (pattern declared at :468-470).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one phone-number candidate with its expected structural verdict.

phone.description: Phone-number candidate. Valid vectors match the Swift NANP regex; invalid vectors deliberately deviate.

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches the Swift phone regex shape.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this phone, or null if valid.
